title: Finite extension with depth two at every point above the boundary
statement: Let $L$ be a locally Noetherian scheme, meaning it has an affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $U$ be an open of $L$. Assume $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{L,y}\geq2$ for every $y\notin U$ [def-weil-pbc-depth]. For every finite etale morphism $f:X\to U$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism], there exist a finite $p:E\to L$ and an isomorphism $e:E|_U\cong X$ over $U$, such that $\operatorname{depth}\mathcal O_{E,z}\geq2$ whenever $p(z)\notin U$. No etaleness of $p$, smooth base, or fibre-density assumption is asserted or required.

source.place: Tag 0EY6(1),(2); coherence step expanded using coherent extension and double duals, Tag 0E9I, and Tag 0AUK

proof.text: On an affine Noetherian open V of L, extend the finite locally free module f_* O_X from U intersect V to a finite coherent module M. Such an extension exists because this open is quasi-compact. The double dual N of M still agrees with f_* O_X there. At a boundary stalk of depth at least two, a finite presentation of the dual of M realizes N as the kernel of a map between finite free modules. Choose a regular pair x,y in the local ring. The element x acts injectively on N; if y n = x nprime in N, regularity in the free source gives n = x m. Since x d(m) = 0 in the free target, d(m) = 0, so m belongs to N. Thus the pair is regular on N and depth N is at least two. Apply the depth-two Hartogs isomorphism, Tag 0E9I, to identify N with j_* f_* O_X on V. This proves coherence of the canonical pushforward algebra B locally, without integrality or normality.

The canonical algebra B = j_* f_* O_X defines E = relative Spec_L B. Coherence makes p finite. Its restriction is relative Spec_U(f_* O_X), canonically X, and the relative-spectrum identification gives e and its equation over U. The depth estimate for B at every missing stalk and the finite-algebra depth comparison 0AUK give depth O(E,z) at least two for every z above the boundary. These constructions agree on affine overlaps since B is defined by pushforward, so they glue for arbitrary locally Noetherian L. Empty covers produce the zero algebra; for U = L the construction recovers X.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_extension_of_depth_two
    {L : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian L] (U : L.Opens)
    (hboundary : ∀ y : L, y ∉ U →
      (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := L.presheaf.stalk y) (L.presheaf.stalk y))
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ U.toScheme) [IsFinite f] [Etale f] :
    ∃ (E : Scheme.{u}) (p : E ⟶ L), IsFinite p ∧
      (∀ z : E, p z ∉ U →
        (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := E.presheaf.stalk z) (E.presheaf.stalk z)) ∧
      ∃ e : (p ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme ≅ X, e.hom ≫ f = p ∣_ U
